answer_4.quote: We recruited 10 graduate students in machine learning (not authors of this paper) to perform the study.
answer_4.guideline: Users are given the input of a GPT-2 model, two choices for the next token, and an explanation for the model output. They are asked to select which of the two choices is more likely the model output, then answer whether the explanation was useful in making their decision.
